name: Smallpdf Pro
tagline: The core loop is buildable, but a dependable replacement becomes a real weekend or multi-day project. For Smallpdf Pro, offer common PDF transformations through a private self-hosted interface. The hard boundary is hosted convenience, broad tools, mobile apps, signatures, ocr, and high-volume processing, plus document fidelity, identity, and compliance.
